Definition: {between (repeated before each noun, often with other particles); also as a conjunction, either...or}
BiblicalUsage: In Scripture beyn means between, among, and it shows up twice, in Daniel 7:5 and Daniel 7:8.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe beyn still matters, even appearing only a few times, because God chose it.
